Privacy and respectful community participation

Use the platform without oversharing.

Public tools should collect as little information as practical. Do not enter private client, patient, financial, account or emergency details into public planners.

Built for Franklin

Not a national directory with a Franklin label. Profiles, local tools, participation paths and membership are organized around the Franklin community itself.

  • Free factual profile review and corrections
  • Clear local participation tools
  • Simple Community Membership choices

Public profiles and factual corrections

Profiles are built from qualified public or organization sources and member-provided content is kept conceptually separate. Factual review and corrections remain free. Public profile presence does not mean consent to marketing.

Device-only tools

Ask Franklin Assistant, profile previews and many planners operate in your browser. My Franklin may store selected topics, reminders and public profile bookmarks on the device when you choose to save them. Clearing browser storage removes device-local information.

See member options requests

The pre-enrollment pages create a summary or open your email application. Do not include confidential records. Email is handled by your email provider and Franklin Navigator’s email service under their respective systems.

Accounts and payments when activated

Secure member accounts use only the limited information needed to sign in, confirm which profile you manage, maintain your membership and provide support. Payment card details are processed by Stripe rather than stored directly by Franklin Navigator. Account and billing features are used only for signed-in membership activity.

Growth Desk and public business contacts

Franklin Navigator may maintain public business and official-work contact information from public sources. A public contact route is not permission to contact someone for marketing. Before any outreach, current source checks, do-not-contact preferences, duplicate checks, regulated-field rules and language evidence still apply. Members do not receive an unrestricted raw email database.

Language

Do not infer a person’s preferred language from surname, ethnicity, nationality, race or appearance. English, Spanish or bilingual preparation should follow actual language evidence and appropriate review.

Hosting and external links

Hosting and security providers may process basic request information such as IP address, browser type, requested page and timing. External websites control their own privacy practices.
